blocks.text:
The Now Playing card takes the album art's colour, and the sound bars in the island take a lighter version of it, so whatever is playing colours both of the places Folio shows it.

Folio reads the strongest colour out of the artwork and mixes it into the card's glass, fading from one track's colour to the next rather than snapping. Artwork with no real colour in it - a grey cover, a black-and-white photograph - leaves the card and the bars as they are.

Like every tweak it has its own page in Settings › Tweaks, with a switch for the cover screen and a switch for the inner one, so it can be on where it helps and off where it doesn't.

Inspired by ColorFlow by David Goldman. Re-created from scratch for Folio; no tweak code is included.

items: Now Playing takes the album art's colour
The island's sound bars follow, a shade lighter
It fades from one track's colour to the next

entries.notes: Colored Albums becomes a package in the Folio Market. The tweak itself has shipped with Folio since 0.6.0. Called Colored Albums until 0.6.8, when it was renamed Afterglow.
